name: Charleston
tagline: Southern Charm, Historic Architecture, and Lowcountry Living
description: Charleston is consistently ranked among America's most beautiful and hospitable cities. Its cobblestone streets, antebellum architecture, and world-class dining scene create a unique atmosphere that blends history with modern sophistication. The cost of living is moderate by coastal standards, South Carolina has relatively low taxes, and the subtropical climate allows for year-round outdoor enjoyment. The Lowcountry's beaches, marshlands, and waterways provide endless recreation for FIRE retirees.

quickFacts.visa: No visa required for US citizens
quickFacts.safetyRating: Moderate – safe in historic and suburban areas
quickFacts.climate: Subtropical with hot, humid summers and mild winters

housing.description: Cheapest-acceptable studio or older 1BR in a value area — West Ashley, North Charleston, or James Island

dining.description: Casual Lowcountry fare a few times a week; shrimp-and-grits spots and BBQ joints; mostly home cooking

healthcare.description: ACA marketplace Silver plan on the SC exchange, subsidized if MAGI is kept under the 2026 400%-FPL cliff (~$62,600 single); assumes an early retiree (45–55) — older retirees budget more

transportation.description: A paid-off used car with insurance and gas; Charleston requires a car, and SC auto premiums run high

entertainment.description: Free walks on the Battery, beach days at Folly Beach, historic-district strolls

1M.lifestyle: A cheapest-acceptable studio or older one-bedroom in a value area like West Ashley, North Charleston, or James Island rather than the peninsula, where housing still takes a large share. Free walks on the Battery, beach days at Folly Beach, and affordable shrimp-and-grits spots keep life enjoyable. Summer A/C bills and higher SC auto premiums are real costs to plan for. Tight but workable with home cooking most nights, in one of America's most beautiful cities.

housing.description: A decent 1BR in a solid area — Mount Pleasant, or a better West Ashley/James Island building

dining.description: Dining out several times a week at Charleston's celebrated restaurants and oyster bars

healthcare.description: A Silver plan; net cost stays low only if MAGI is managed under the ~$62,600 cliff

transportation.description: A reliable mid-range car with full coverage; gas for beach and island trips

entertainment.description: Spoleto Festival tickets, kayaking the salt marshes, a gym membership, golf

2M.lifestyle: A comfortable one-bedroom in Mount Pleasant or a nicer West Ashley building puts the city's restaurant scene within easy reach, with dining out several times a week at celebrated restaurants and oyster bars. A reliable car covers beach and island runs. Weekends mean kayaking the salt marshes, beach time at Isle of Palms, and events like Spoleto. A relaxed, comfortable Lowcountry life.

housing.description: A high-quality 1BR or small place downtown on the peninsula or in Mount Pleasant

dining.description: Regular dining at FIG, Husk, and The Ordinary; oyster roasts

healthcare.description: A Gold-tier plan with MUSC network access; padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff where premium tax credits phase out

transportation.description: A late-model SUV, premium insurance, fuel for harbor and island excursions

entertainment.description: A golf club membership, sailing on Charleston Harbor, Spoleto patron, premium gym

3M.lifestyle: A high-quality place on the historic peninsula or in Mount Pleasant, with regular dinners at FIG, Husk, and The Ordinary. A golf membership and weekend sailing on the harbor fit comfortably, and healthcare runs through the MUSC network, padded near the ~$62,600 ACA cliff. A late-model SUV covers island excursions. A genuinely affluent Charleston life with room for regular travel.

housing.description: A luxury peninsula condo or a smaller historic-district or waterfront place — South of Broad edge, Sullivan's Island, or Kiawah

dining.description: Fine dining several nights a week plus private-chef Lowcountry dinner parties and a wine cellar

healthcare.description: An unsubsidized Gold/Platinum plan plus concierge medicine at MUSC and preventive care

transportation.description: A luxury vehicle plus a boat for harbor and island hopping, premium insurance

entertainment.description: A Kiawah golf membership, yacht club, Spoleto patron, private tours

domesticHelp.description: Weekly cleaning plus garden and boat upkeep

luxuryExtras.description: Quarterly travel, antique collecting, historic-preservation philanthropy, spa retreats

5M.lifestyle: A luxury condo or a smaller historic or waterfront place near South of Broad, on Sullivan's Island, or at Kiawah, with weekly housekeeping and concierge medicine at MUSC. Fine dining several nights a week, a Kiawah golf membership, and a boat for harbor and island hopping all fit. Business class travel and regular entertaining are comfortable. Charleston's high-end real estate absorbs a fair share, but daily life feels very well-appointed.

housing.description: A landmark historic estate South of Broad or a private compound on Kiawah Island

dining.description: A private chef specializing in Lowcountry cuisine, exclusive wine events, catered soirées

healthcare.description: A top-tier unsubsidized concierge practice at MUSC plus executive screenings — fully out of subsidy range

transportation.description: Multiple luxury vehicles, a private yacht, a driver for events and travel

entertainment.description: Philanthropic galas, art and antique collecting, international travel, private club memberships

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper, estate manager, boat captain, and garden staff

luxuryExtras.description: Historic-preservation endowments, European travel, a second home, a charitable foundation

10M.lifestyle: A landmark historic estate South of Broad or a private Kiawah Island compound, full-time domestic staff including an estate manager and boat captain, and a private chef several days a week. First-class travel, fine dining whenever desired, and a yacht for the harbor and barrier islands come standard, alongside top-tier concierge care at MUSC. Charleston's preservation community and cultural scene offer real ways to get involved. Housing absorbs a meaningful share, but the lifestyle is uncapped — roughly $240k a year.
